title: HUMAN FEEDBACK IS NOT GOLD STANDARD

bias_targets.methodology: Generating model outputs with varying levels of assertiveness using hidden preambles, and comparing the error detection rates (especially for factuality and inconsistency) of crowdsourced human annotators against expert annotators to reveal over-trust in confident text.

Generating model outputs with varying levels of linguistic complexity using hidden preambles, and analyzing how the complexity of the language affects crowdsourced human annotators' ability to accurately detect errors compared to expert annotators.
